steps.title: Collect oropharyngeal swabs
steps.instruction: Insert a sterile swab into the trachea via the oral cavity, rotate for several seconds, place the swab in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube containing 1 mL 1× PBS, and keep on ice or refrigerated until processing.

steps.title: Extract nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Use 200 µL of each swab suspension as input for the MagMAX Viral/Pathogen I Nucleic Acid Isolation kit on a KingFisher Flex robot, following the manufacturer’s protocol; aliquot 10 µL of purified nucleic acid into 0.2 mL PCR tubes and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare LAMP primer stocks
steps.instruction: Reconstitute each primer to 100 µM with autoclaved Milli‑Q water, vortex briefly, spin down, and keep on ice for 20 min; then dilute to the concentrations listed in Tables 2–3, aliquot 60 µL of each primer mix into labeled tubes, and freeze at –20 °C.

steps.title: Assemble LAMP reaction (purified template)
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL real‑time PCR tube add 12.5 µL WarmStart master mix (1×), 4 µL Milli‑Q water, 2.5 µL purified nucleic‑acid template, and 6 µL primer mix (final concentrations: FIP/BIP 0.16 µM, F3/B3 0.1 µM, loop 0.2 µM); vortex, centrifuge, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Run LAMP thermal cycle
steps.instruction: Incubate at 65 °C for 30 min, then 80 °C for 5 min for enzyme inactivation; hold the tubes at 4 °C until electrophoresis.

steps.title: Agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 % agarose gel in 1× TAE with 700 µL of 100× GelRed per 100 mL gel; mix 1 µL 6× DNA loading buffer with 5 µL LAMP product, load 5 µL of 50 bp ladder, run at 100 V for 30 min, then visualize.

steps.title: Quantitative LAMP (purified template)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL qLAMP mix: 6 µL primer mix (0.16 µM FIP/BIP, 0.1 µM F3/B3, 0.2 µM loop), 12.5 µL WarmStart master mix (1×), 0.5 µL LAMP fluorescent dye, 3.5 µL Milli‑Q water, 2.5 µL template; vortex, spin, place on ice, then run on QuantStudio 5 at 65 °C for 40 min with melt‑curve (95 °C 15 s → 60 °C 1 min → 95 °C 1 s) and record fluorescence each minute (40 cycles).

steps.title: Quantitative LAMP (crude sample)
steps.instruction: Thaw crude swab suspensions on ice; assemble a 25 µL qLAMP mix: 6 µL primer mix, 12.5 µL WarmStart master mix, 0.5 µL fluorescent dye, 1 µL Milli‑Q water, 5 µL crude sample; vortex, spin, ice, then run on QuantStudio 5 at 65 °C for 30 min with the same melt‑curve and 40‑cycle fluorescence acquisition.

steps.title: Synthesize gold nanoparticles (AuNPs)
steps.instruction: Heat 30 mL Milli‑Q water in a 50 mL Erlenmeyer flask on a hotplate at 100 °C with vigorous stirring; when boiling, add 40 µL of 50 mM HAuCl₄, immediately add trisodium citrate to 1 % (v/v) final concentration, reflux 10 min; add another 40 µL 50 mM HAuCl₄ and reflux 10 min; cool to room temperature, centrifuge 8,000×g 10 min in 1× PBS, discard supernatant if nanoparticles remain, keep the pellet, measure UV‑Vis, adjust to absorbance 1.5 (518–524 nm), and store at 4 °C in 2 mL glass vials.

steps.title: Design and prepare DNA nanoprobes
steps.instruction: Design an 18‑nt single‑stranded probe complementary to the LAMP amplicon, add a 5′‑thiol modification, order HPLC‑purified, resuspend lyophilized oligo in nuclease‑free water to 100 µM, aliquot 50 µL and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Reduce thiolated probes with DTT
steps.instruction: Make fresh 50 mM DTT in 1× PBS (pH 8.0); mix 50 µL thiolated probe with 450 µL DTT solution (≥100‑fold molar excess), incubate 30 min at room temperature; add 1 mL cold 100 % ethanol (–20 °C), keep –20 °C 2 h; add 50 µL 3 M sodium acetate, freeze –20 °C overnight; centrifuge 20,000×g 15 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash pellet with 500 µL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 20,000×g 10 min (4 °C), repeat wash, centrifuge 20,000×g 8 min (4 °C), discard supernatant, air‑dry, resuspend in 50 µL Milli‑Q water, aliquot 50 µL (≈50 µM) and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Functionalize AuNPs with DNA probes
steps.instruction: Incubate 2 mL 20 nm AuNPs with 80 µL reduced thiolated probe (50 µM) for 16 h at room temperature in the dark; split into two 1 mL aliquots, add 40 µL 5 M NaCl to each, incubate 2 h RT dark; add 0.17 µL 20 % Tween‑20 to each; perform salt‑aging in a SpeedVac at 42 °C for 2–4 h until volume ≈250 µL; add 90 µL 0.1× PBS and 800 µL 0.1× PBS + 0.1 M NaCl to each tube; centrifuge 6,700×g (10,000 rpm) 15 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 50 µL 1× PBS, keep 5 µL for gel analysis and add 450 µL 1× PBS to the rest; homogenize on a rotator at 6,700×g for 10 min, repeat the washing steps once; centrifuge 4,300×g (8,000 rpm) 5 min (extend if needed), resuspend pellet in 50 µL 1× PBS; if aggregated, heat‑shock 56 °C 5 min; record UV‑Vis, adjust absorbance to ≈1.5 at 522 nm, store functionalized AuNPs at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare binding buffer
steps.instruction: Mix to obtain 150 µL stock solution containing 5 M NaCl (2 M final), 2 M MgCl₂ (1 M final), 20 % Tween‑20 (0.03 % final), and 150 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (25 mM final); keep at room temperature and protect from light; this buffer is stable for up to one week.

steps.title: Visualize LAMP product with nanoprobes
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL PCR tube add 5 µL LAMP product (fresh or warmed to 65 °C if stored), add 8.5 µL binding buffer, then add 1.5 µL DNA‑functionalized AuNPs (do not mix until addition); incubate at room temperature for 5 min, then record absorbance from 400–700 nm, focusing on the 540 nm peak (color remains red for positive samples, fades for negatives).

steps.title: Amplify gene fragment for cloning
steps.instruction: Set up a 20 µL PCR with 1 µL 10 µM F3 primer, 1 µL 10 µM B3 primer, 17 µL nuclease‑free water, and 1 µL template using Maxime™ PCR PreMix i‑Taq; run program: 95 °C 2 min; 30 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 56 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 5 min.

steps.title: Ligate PCR product into TOPO vector
steps.instruction: Combine 2 µL nuclease‑free water, 2 µL PCR product, 1 µL pCR4‑TOPO vector, and 1 µL salt solution (total 6 µL); incubate 37 °C 10 min.

steps.title: Transform TOP10 E. coli
steps.instruction: Mix 6 µL ligation product with 50 µL TOP10 competent cells, ice 30 min, heat‑shock 42 °C 1 min, ice, add 250 µL SOC medium, incubate 37 °C 1 h shaking at 750 rpm, plate 200 µL on LB agar with ampicillin and 40 µL 40 mg/mL X‑GAL (in dimethylformamide), incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Screen colonies by PCR
steps.instruction: Pick single colonies, add each to a 20 µL PCR containing 1 µL 10 pmol/µL M13‑Forward, 1 µL 10 pmol/µL M13‑Reverse, 18 µL nuclease‑free water, and Maxime™ PCR PreMix i‑Taq; run the same program as above; analyze products on a 2 % agarose gel as described for LAMP; extract plasmid from positive clones using NZYSpeedy Miniprep kit.

steps.title: Quantify plasmid and determine LOD
steps.instruction: Measure plasmid concentration with a Qubit fluorometer using 1.5 µL sample; store remaining 40 µL at –80 °C; prepare 1:5 serial dilutions of the plasmid, then amplify each dilution with the qLAMP assay (section A) to establish the limit of detection.
